ng-add.description: Wire ngwr into the workspace — install peer deps, add `@use 'ngwr/theme';` to the top of the global styles, and print next-steps for providers and per-component styles.

icon-set.description: Scaffold a tree-shaken ngwr icon barrel file.

use.description: Add an `import { WrFoo } from 'ngwr/<subpath>';` line and splice WrFoo into the @Component imports array of a component file.

provider.description: Add a provider to your app config: `provideWrIcons()` / `provideWrI18n()` / `provideWrLoadingBarRouter()`, or a `withToast()` / `withDensity()` / `withStorage()` / `withTheme()` feature inside `provideWr()`.

component-style.description: Add `@use 'ngwr/<name>';` to the project's global stylesheet, after the theme line — every component you render needs its own.

page.description: Scaffold a starter page (form / table / dashboard) wired up with ngwr components.
